title: Move billing-api session cache from memcached to redis
body:
billing-api now uses redis for its session cache instead of memcached.
The memcached cluster can be decommissioned after this ships.

title: Proposal: call fraud-check before charging
body:
Draft: billing-api would call fraud-check synchronously before each charge.
Not merged; under discussion.

title: Switch billing-api invoice events to kafka
body:
billing-api would publish invoice events to kafka instead of SQS.
Closed: we decided to keep SQS.
